summary: Frontend-only regression for the final logo swap (WebP artwork provided by user). Verified single reusable Logo.jsx component now drives every placement (launch, countdown, celebration, coming-soon, header on 404, plus art-merge and art-identity scene overlays). Asset served from /brand/lokager-logo.webp (SHA256 bf39ce6e... matches expected), natural size 2000x751, object-fit: contain, complete=true at every placement. Full 60s countdown -> 700ms zero-hold -> 9s celebration -> coming-soon sequence completed end-to-end with no console errors and zero /api requests. No old Wordmark/LogoMark/wordmarkPaths references remain. 1366x768 countdown no longer overflows (iteration_4 regression fixed: scrollHeight==viewportHeight==768).

measurements.natural_size: 2000x751 at every placement (launch, countdown, celebration, coming-soon, header, art-merge, art-identity)
measurements.logo_box_at_lg: 760x294.8 (h respects intrinsic aspect via object-contain, sm+ 364x136 and mobile 260x97)
measurements.countdown_1366x768_scroll: scrollHeight=768, viewportHeight=768 (0px vertical scroll, iteration_4 regression FIXED)
measurements.sequence_timing: manual click -> countdown 60s -> celebration reached -> coming-soon reached (all within ~70s)
measurements.merge_scene_index_2: art-merge-logo-image present, complete=true, nw=2000 (screenshot merge_scene.png shows small LOKAGER logo over globe circle in left panel)
measurements.identity_scene_index_17: art-identity-logo-image present, complete=true, nw=2000 (screenshot identity_scene.png shows LOKAGER logo inside concentric circle panel on right)
measurements.celebration_heading_semantics: single H1 with text 'LOKAGER' (no duplicate full lockup - upper mark slot has full logo, semantic announcement below is text-only)
measurements.idle_on_reload: confirmed - reload on / keeps phase=idle until manual launch click
measurements.404_header_logo: header-logo-image loads same asset, back-home-button navigates to / launch idle

critical_code_review_comments: Logo.jsx sizes are correct and preserve former slot heights; note the `md` slot height (97.2px) is slightly larger than the intrinsic aspect for its width (260 * 751/2000 ~= 97.6px), so object-contain fits perfectly with no visible letterboxing.

manifest.json declares a single icon at 2000x751 which is fine for now but PWA installability audits typically expect maskable 192/512 square icons; not required for launch ceremony scope, flag for post-swap follow-up when the final Canva SVG lands.
Chime playback depends on user gesture (unlockAudio on click) - working as designed.
